# function: clouddirectory_applied_schema

Builds the ARN of an `clouddirectory` `appliedSchema`:

```
arn:${Partition}:clouddirectory:${Region}:${Account}:directory/${DirectoryId}/schema/${SchemaName}/${Version}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
clouddirectory_applied_schema(directory_id string, schema_name string, version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `directory_id` (String) Value for `${DirectoryId}` in the ARN template.
1. `schema_name` (String) Value for `${SchemaName}` in the ARN template.
1. `version` (String) Value for `${Version}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
